items.title: Punjab Assembly begins evaluation of AI use in public services
items.description:
LAHORE: The Punjab Assembly has begun parliamentary evaluation of artificial intelligence and digital governance, with its Special Committee No. 13 examining the use of AI in public services and the safeguards needed to protect citizens’ rights.
Chaired by Speaker Malik Muhammad Ahmad Khan, the committee held its inaugural meeting on Thursday.
It is the first parliamentary committee in Pakistan and the South Asian region with a dedicated mandate covering artificial intelligence and digital governance.

items.title: Pakistan ranked among bottom three in WEF's Global Gender Gap Report 2026
items.description:
Pakistan ranked third-to-last in the World Economic Forum’s (WEF) Global Gender Gap Report 2026, with 59.5 per cent gender parity, up almost 3pc from last year.
The annual report benchmarked the current state and evolution of gender parity across four key dimensions: economic participation and opportunity, educational attainment, health and survival, and political empowerment.
Pakistan scored the lowest out of the 38 lower-middle-income economies, as well as the seven South Asian countries, included in the report.

items.title: Pakistan committed to implementing Saudi defence pact, Makkah agreement: FO
items.description:
Pakistan on Thursday said it remained committed “in intent and spirit” to implementing the Strategic Mutual Defence Agreement (SMDA) with Saudi Arabia and the trilateral Makkah Defence Alliance.
Foreign Office (FO) spokesperson Sajjad Haider Khan made the statement during his weekly briefing.
The statement comes amid renewed tensions in the Middle East, with Yemen’s Houthi rebels carrying out attacks in Saudi Arabia in recent days.
